description: This file defines the TestDataService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility functions to load, insert, delete, and manage test fixture data in a database, primarily for testing purposes. It includes methods for populating fixture data, truncating tables, fetching records, and converting fixture data into entity objects.

classes.name: TestDataService
classes.description: Utility class for managing test fixture data, including loading, inserting, and clearing database data for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Loads fixture data from a specified file and populates the database with this data, optionally resetting cache.

methods.name: _populateUsingPdoTransaction
methods.description: Handles the database transaction to insert fixture data via PDO, managing transaction control and error handling.

methods.name: _generatePdoInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generates an array of SQL insert queries for a given table and its data.

methods.name: _generateMultipleInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Constructs multiple insert SQL statements for batch inserting fixture data.

methods.name: _generateInsetQueryColumnString
methods.description: Generates the column part of an insert SQL statement based on fixture data.

methods.name: _getTableName
methods.description: Retrieves the database table name for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _getClassMetadata
methods.description: Fetches Doctrine ClassMetadata for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _setData
methods.description: Loads fixture data from YAML file into internal data structures.

methods.name: _encryptFieldsInFixture
methods.description: Encrypts specified model fields in fixture data if encryption keys are available.

methods.name: getFQEntityName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name for a given entity class, checking namespace conventions.

methods.name: _setTableNames
methods.description: Populates the internal list of table names based on the fixture data.

methods.name: _disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints temporarily in the database.

methods.name: _enableConstraints
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key constraints after data operations.

methods.name: _truncateTables
methods.description: Deletes all data from specified tables, resetting auto-increment counters.

methods.name: _getDbConnection
methods.description: Obtains the PDO database connection from Doctrine.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Public method to truncate tables based on an array of entity aliases.

methods.name: truncateSpecificTables
methods.description: Truncates specific tables identified by their entity aliases.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecords
methods.description: Retrieves the last 'n' inserted records for a given entity.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecord
methods.description: Fetches the most recent inserted record from a given entity, ordered by a specified attribute.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity object by primary key.

methods.name: parseFixtureFile
methods.description: Parses a YAML fixture file into an array.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads specific fixture data keyed within a fixture file.

methods.name: loadObjectList
methods.description: Loads and converts fixture data into entity objects for a specific class.

methods.name: loadObjectListFromArray
methods.description: Converts an array of fixture data into a list of entity objects for a specified class.

methods.name: getFieldForColumn
methods.description: Finds the field name mapping for a given database column.

methods.name: getTypeForField
methods.description: Gets the data type of a specific entity field.

methods.name: getAssociationMapping
methods.description: Retrieves association mapping information for a given entity field.
